title: Sheaves of modules on a scheme form a Grothendieck abelian category
statement: For every scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], the category $X.\mathrm{Modules}$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is Grothendieck abelian: it is abelian, has all small colimits, and filtered colimits (hence set-indexed direct sums) are exact.
